title: Models by provider: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta and xAI

videos.script: This is the lesson in this course that will go out of date first. {{date}} Model names change every few months. Prices change. Models are retired. {{change}} So it does two things. It names the five large providers in the title, and the families of models each one offers, as they stand in 2026. {{names}} And it teaches you how to check, because what you read here will be partly wrong within a year. {{check}} You will see the difference between a model you can only call through an interface, and one whose weights you can download and run. {{open}} Then you will see why a price per token cannot be compared across providers, using a real tokenizer on one sentence. {{tokens}} The lasting skill is choosing a model on your own test cases, not on a table. {{choose}}
